FINAL FANTASY XIV toolkits # Divination

## Disclaimer

⚠️ All our plugins must be used at your own risk.

## Installation

Add `https://xiv.starry.blue/plugins/master.json` to your custom plugin repositories.

After the Dalamud API level is updated, plugins in the Stable channel will not be updated immediately. If you need updates promptly, configure your Dalamud to receive updates from the Testing channel.

01daabc: fix(FaloopIntegration): connect to Faloop's new Socket.IO endpoint

Faloop's frontend update (2026-10-30) moved the Socket.IO endpoint from
/comms/socket.io to the /legacy namespace on /messaging/socket.io/.
The old endpoint still accepts connections but no longer delivers mob
reports, so follow the new endpoint.

d2ea413: feat: use a divination-deploy App token instead of DEPLOY_GITHUB_TOKEN (#799)

reusable-deploy-plugin.yml checks out the distribution repository, opens
a pull request there and merges it. Mint a GitHub App installation token
scoped to that repository instead of using a bot PAT.

Drop the Authorization header when fetching commits.json. This
repository is public so the request needs no authentication, and
expanding a token on the command line exposes it through the process
list.

Reference the reusable workflow by local path. Pinning it by SHA means a
change here does not take effect until every caller is updated, which
would leave a broken intermediate state whenever a secret is renamed.

Drop the explicit create-pull-request author: it defaults to
github.actor, which attributes the deployment to whoever triggered it.

8b422a6: Merge pull request #805 from SlashNephy/fix/faloop-messaging-socket

fix(FaloopIntegration): connect to Faloop's new Socket.IO endpoint
01daabc: fix(FaloopIntegration): connect to Faloop's new Socket.IO endpoint

Faloop's frontend update (2026-10-30) moved the Socket.IO endpoint from
/comms/socket.io to the /legacy namespace on /messaging/socket.io/.
The old endpoint still accepts connections but no longer delivers mob
reports, so follow the new endpoint.

Close #804

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
d2ea413: feat: use a divination-deploy App token instead of DEPLOY_GITHUB_TOKEN (#799)

reusable-deploy-plugin.yml checks out the distribution repository, opens
a pull request there and merges it. Mint a GitHub App installation token
scoped to that repository instead of using a bot PAT.

Drop the Authorization header when fetching commits.json. This
repository is public so the request needs no authentication, and
expanding a token on the command line exposes it through the process
list.

Reference the reusable workflow by local path. Pinning it by SHA means a
change here does not take effect until every caller is updated, which
would leave a broken intermediate state whenever a secret is renamed.

Drop the explicit create-pull-request author: it defaults to
github.actor, which attributes the deployment to whoever triggered it.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

variant.changelog:
8b422a6: Merge pull request #805 from SlashNephy/fix/faloop-messaging-socket

fix(FaloopIntegration): connect to Faloop's new Socket.IO endpoint
01daabc: fix(FaloopIntegration): connect to Faloop's new Socket.IO endpoint

Faloop's frontend update (2026-10-30) moved the Socket.IO endpoint from
/comms/socket.io to the /legacy namespace on /messaging/socket.io/.
The old endpoint still accepts connections but no longer delivers mob
reports, so follow the new endpoint.

Close #804

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
d2ea413: feat: use a divination-deploy App token instead of DEPLOY_GITHUB_TOKEN (#799)

reusable-deploy-plugin.yml checks out the distribution repository, opens
a pull request there and merges it. Mint a GitHub App installation token
scoped to that repository instead of using a bot PAT.

Drop the Authorization header when fetching commits.json. This
repository is public so the request needs no authentication, and
expanding a token on the command line exposes it through the process
list.

Reference the reusable workflow by local path. Pinning it by SHA means a
change here does not take effect until every caller is updated, which
would leave a broken intermediate state whenever a secret is renamed.

Drop the explicit create-pull-request author: it defaults to
github.actor, which attributes the deployment to whoever triggered it.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
